Aqui いた é o passado de いる, então a ação 'só dormir' aconteceu de forma contínua no passado.

structure_explanation.en: The target is さすが, here in the adverbial form さすがに, which opens the sentence with the sense of 'let's be honest / of course / in the end, even I admit'. It is followed by それは (それ 'that' + topic は) and the predicate やりすぎだ. やりすぎ comes from the verb やる ('to do') with the suffix すぎ ('in excess'), and だ is the copula ('is'). The structure is therefore 'さすがに + topic + predicate': 'honestly, THIS is already too much'.

A estrutura é, então, 'さすがに + tópico + predicado': 'convenhamos, ISSO já é demais'.

before.jp: 今月は忙しいので、暇な日がありません。
before.kana: こんげつわいそがしいので、ひまなひがありません。

structure_explanation.en: The sentence has two parts linked by ので ('since/because'): the first, 今月は忙しい ('this month I'm busy'), explains the second, 暇な日がありません ('there is no free day'). 暇な is the na-adjective 暇 ('free/idle') modifying 日 ('day'), and ありません is the polite negative form of ある ('to exist/there is'). Since it is a coverage sentence, it practices the causal connector ので and the polite negation of existence.

Como é frase de cobertura, ela prática o conector causal ので e a negação polida de existência.

ops.issue: 九時 as a clock time is always read くじ, never きゅうじ (like 四時=よじ, 七時=しちじ). The kana gives ごぜんきゅうじ, teaching a wrong time reading — core N5 material.

structure_explanation.en: The topic 図書館は ('as for the library') is followed by a time interval formed by 〜から ('from') and 〜まで ('until'): 午前九時から ('from 9 a.m.') 午後八時まで ('until 8 p.m.'). The sentence ends in です, which here functions as 'it is (so)', stating the hours. The target is coverage of hours (午前/午後, 〜時) and the pair から〜まで.

structure_explanation.en: Two parts linked by conditional と, here 'whenever/when': passing by '通る' always triggers '思いだす' (to remember). 小学校の前 ('the front of the elementary school') is the place passed, by を because 通る treats the route as a path. 子供のころ ('childhood') is what's remembered, also by を as object of 思いだす. Target is N4 grammar; central is the conditional/temporal と of natural consequence.

Na segunda parte, 子供のころ ('a época de criança') é o que se lembra, também marcado por を como objeto de 思いだす. O foco é cobertura de gramática N4, e aqui o ponto central é o と condicional/temporal de consequência natural.

after.kana: しょうがっこうのまえをとおるとこどものころをおもいだす。

structure_explanation.en: Two parts linked by conditional と, here 'whenever/when': passing by '通る' always triggers '思いだす' (to remember). 小学校の前 ('the front of the elementary school') is the place passed, by を because 通る treats the route as a path. 子供のころ ('childhood') is what's remembered, also by を as object of 思いだす. The central point is the conditional/temporal と of natural consequence.
structure_explanation.pt-BR: A frase tem duas partes ligadas pela partícula condicional と, que aqui indica 'sempre que / quando': o ato de '通る' (passar) sempre dispara o resultado '思いだす' (lembrar). 小学校の前 ('a frente da escola primária') é o lugar por onde se passa, marcado por を porque 通る trata o trajeto como percurso. Na segunda parte, 子供のころ ('a época de criança') é o que se lembra, também marcado por を como objeto de 思いだす. O ponto central aqui é o と condicional/temporal de consequência natural.

before.jp: やりがいがひとつ無くなったって感じ。
before.kana: やりがいがひとつなくなったってかんじ。

structure_explanation.en: The focus is 〜って感じ, a colloquial expression = 'like / it gives the feeling of'. The clause 〜が無くなった ('a [reason] disappeared/was lost') is followed by って (colloquial form of という/と) + 感じ, turning it all into a subjective impression: 'it's like the feeling that...'. Note that the tokenizer's 「たって」 is actually the past 〜た + the quotative particle って.
structure_explanation.pt-BR: O foco é 〜って感じ, expressão coloquial = 'tipo assim / dá uma sensação de'. A oração 〜が無くなった ('um [motivo] sumiu/se perdeu') é seguida de って (forma coloquial de という/と) + 感じ, transformando tudo numa impressão subjetiva: 'é tipo a sensação de que...'. Note que 「たって」 do tokenizador é, na verdade, o passado 〜た + a partícula citativa って.
